name: Teacher mode
description: A role pack for teachers: turns the kit's content capabilities into ready-to-use classroom deliverables. Ships five job-skills — worksheet, practice-quiz, differentiation, cover-lesson, and teaching-unit — each kit-blind (it degrades to a plain markdown artifact when the kit lacks a richer capability) and each producing classroom material in the teacher's profile language — the shipped examples are German — under the pack's guardrails. Activate it conversationally ('switch to teacher mode').

activation.note: Conversational and in-place — there is no install. When the agent hears one of these, it announces the switch and offers the pack's jobs; the user can leave the mode just as conversationally.

capabilities.purpose: Read the kit's didactic articles as the raw material a worksheet or quiz is built from.
Pull term definitions for vocabulary tasks and differentiation.
Produce a print-ready handout; on a kit without print export, fall back to a plain markdown handout.
Turn the printable handout into a PDF and check it fits the page count the teacher wants; without it, the teacher prints the HTML handout from the browser.
A Word version with real headings, lists and the document language for screen-reader users or teachers who edit in Word; without it, hand over the markdown version.
Check the handout for accessibility problems by the kit's A11Y rules; without it, add a short manual checklist to the handover note.
Pack a handout or learning page with its images, fonts and scripts into one file for e-mail or a school platform such as Moodle; without it, hand over the HTML file together with the files it uses.
Advice on sentence length and long words for the easier variants and Easy-Language material; without it, read by eye and say that no measure ran.
